endings.name: The Flake
endings.summary: The bark was over-tapped and over-carved. At the touch a plate gives and a district falls away. In the backyard a flake drops into the grass and nobody looks up.

endings.name: The War on the God
endings.summary: The Battlements lead, and read the Shadow as an enemy. The warriors climb the knuckle and Burr strikes. In the backyard someone picks out a splinter and goes inside. On the bark it is the greatest victory in history.

endings.name: The Edge of the World
endings.summary: The Scroll House leads and read the Shadow as a thing with a habit. The scholars stake its outline; Fenn draws the first map with an edge on it, and the city argues over whether it is heresy.

endings.name: The Shadow Passes
endings.summary: The story's own path: the priests chant, the warriors stand ready, the scholars record. The hand taps, presses a crack and goes away. The view pulls back to the backyard, and the moral closes the game.
